timeseries avg(aerospike_node_stats_uptime), by: { cluster_name }
| fields cluster_name

timeseries avg(aerospike_node_stats_uptime, filter: { in(cluster_name, array($cluster)) }), by: { service }
| fields service

timeseries avg(ALERTS), by: { severity }
| fields severity

0.content: **Multi Cluster View**: All clusters on one page: latency and XDR lag (the map and topology panels are notes for now). A tile's description shows its equivalent Prometheus query.

2.content:
### 

_Not available in Dynatrace yet (a geomap panel). The equivalent Prometheus query:_

```promql
count by (latitude, longitude, cluster_name) (ALERTS{cluster_name!="", job="aerospike", severity=~"critical|warn"}) * -1
or
count by (latitude, longitude, cluster_name) (aerospike_node_up)

```

6.content:
### Cluster Size (Unique values)

_Not available in Dynatrace yet (count_values()). The equivalent Prometheus query:_

```promql
count_values ("size", (aerospike_node_stats_cluster_size{cluster_name="$cluster"}) )
```

7.content:
### Alerts

_Not available in Dynatrace yet (Prometheus alert state (ALERTS) -- alerts are not in Dynatrace). The equivalent Prometheus query:_

```promql
count by (severity) (ALERTS{job="$job_name",cluster_name=~"$cluster", severity=~"$severity"}) or vector(0)
```

8.content:
### $cluster - Nodes

_Not available in Dynatrace yet (a polystat panel). The equivalent Prometheus query:_

```promql
count by (service,cluster_name) (ALERTS{cluster_name="$cluster", service!="", severity=~"critical|warn"}) * -1
or
count by (service,cluster_name) (aerospike_node_up{ cluster_name="$cluster"})
```

9.content:
### $cluster - Namespaces

_Not available in Dynatrace yet (Prometheus alert state (ALERTS) -- alerts are not in Dynatrace). The equivalent Prometheus query:_

```promql
(count by (ns) (ALERTS{cluster_name="$cluster", ns=~"..*", severity=~"critical|warn"}) * -1 
* on (ns) group_left
sum by (ns) (aerospike_namespace_objects{cluster_name="$cluster"} ))
or
sum by (ns) (aerospike_namespace_objects{cluster_name="$cluster"} ) 

```

10.title: XDR Lag (max)
10.query:
timeseries value = max(aerospike_xdr_lag, filter: { in(cluster_name, array($cluster)) })
| fields value = coalesce(value[-2], arrayLast(value))

11.title: Latencies (total)
11.query:
timeseries a0 = sum(aerospike_latencies_write_ms_bucket, filter: { in(cluster_name, array($cluster)) and le == "+Inf" }, rollup: avg), a1 = sum(aerospike_latencies_write_ms_bucket, filter: { in(cluster_name, array($cluster)) and le == "4" }, rollup: avg), a2 = sum(aerospike_latencies_read_ms_bucket, filter: { in(cluster_name, array($cluster)) and le == "+Inf" }, rollup: avg), a3 = sum(aerospike_latencies_read_ms_bucket, filter: { in(cluster_name, array($cluster)) and le == "4" }, rollup: avg)
| fieldsAdd write_4ms = (a0[] - a1[]), read_4ms = (a2[] - a3[])
| fieldsRemove a0, a1, a2, a3
| fields write_4ms = coalesce(write_4ms[-2], arrayLast(write_4ms)), read_4ms = coalesce(read_4ms[-2], arrayLast(read_4ms))
11.description:
Equivalent Prometheus query:
sum (aerospike_latencies_write_ms_bucket{cluster_name=~"$cluster", le="+Inf"})
- 
sum (aerospike_latencies_write_ms_bucket{cluster_name=~"$cluster", le="4"}) 
sum (aerospike_latencies_read_ms_bucket{cluster_name=~"$cluster", le="+Inf",}) 
- 
sum (aerospike_latencies_read_ms_bucket{cluster_name=~"$cluster", le="4",})
